prompt: Add the music at {music} under the whole Splice project {project} on an audio lane, ducked under the narration, and normalized for social loudness. Use the splice MCP tools only.

checks.name: music item
checks.expr: any(media_kind(i['params'].get('media')) == 'audio' for i in items if i['kind'] == 'media')

checks.name: ducked
checks.expr: any(e['type'] == 'duck' for l in lanes for e in l.get('effects', [])) or any('duck' in json.dumps(i) for i in items)
